hook.en: Tea for visitors, a courier, an auto fare: the chief cashier should not be disturbed for every ₹50. A petty cashier handles these small payments.

body.en: A petty cashier is given a fixed amount, called the imprest, at the beginning of a period, say ₹5,000 for a month. He makes small payments out of it and records them. At the end of the period the main cashier reimburses exactly the amount spent, so the petty cashier again starts with the full imprest.
body.kn: ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ಕ್ಯಾಷಿಯರ್‌ಗೆ ನಿಗದಿತ ಮೊತ್ತ (ಇಂಪ್ರೆಸ್ಟ್) ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವಧಿಯ ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಖರ್ಚಾದಷ್ಟು ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಮರುಪಾವತಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Analytical petty cash book

say.en: The petty cashier gets an imprest of 5,000 for July and records each small payment.
Each payment goes in the total column and again in its analysis column.
Total the columns. Only these column totals are posted to the ledger.
On 1 August the main cashier reimburses exactly what was spent, restoring the imprest.

body.en: The receipts column is on the left and the total payments column on the right, followed by analysis columns for each common expense such as postage, stationery, cartage and conveyance. At the end of the period each column is totalled and only the totals are posted to the expense accounts in the ledger.
body.kn: ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ ಕಾಲಂ, ನಂತರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಪಾವತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿ ವೆಚ್ಚಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾಲಂಗಳು. ಕಾಲಂಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಖಾತೆ ಪುಸ್ತಕಕ್ಕೆ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: Reimbursement = Imprest − Balance in hand = total spent. The pie shows how the money was spent.

narration.en: Change the imprest and the spending in each column and read the reimbursement.

tryThis.en: Default values are Hegde & Sons': check the balance is ₹1,300.
Raise refreshments. Does the reimbursement change? Does the imprest?
What happens if total spending exceeds the imprest?

problem.en: The petty cashier of Hegde & Sons receives an imprest of ₹5,000 on 1 July. Payments in July: postage ₹450, stationery ₹820, cartage ₹600, refreshments ₹1,130, conveyance ₹700. Columns: Postage & Stationery, Cartage & Conveyance, Refreshments. Find the column totals, the balance and the reimbursement.

steps.en: On 1 August the main cashier reimburses ₹3,700, restoring the imprest of ₹5,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out step by step. The petty cashier of Hegde & Sons receives an imprest of ₹5,000 on 1 July. Analysis columns let us post only totals to the ledger.

homework.en: Prepare an analytical petty cash book with an imprest of ₹3,000 and six payments of your choice.

narration.en: Recap. Petty cash book records small, frequent payments. Imprest system: reimburse exactly the amount spent. Analysis columns let us post only totals to the ledger.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ನಗದು ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಸಣ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಆಗಾಗ ಆಗುವ ಪಾವತಿಗಳನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇಂಪ್ರೆಸ್ಟ್ ಪದ್ಧತಿ: ಖರ್ಚಾದಷ್ಟೇ ಮರುಪಾವತಿ. ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣಾ ಕಾಲಂಗಳಿಂದ ಮೊತ್ತಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸಬಹುದು.
